audit.whatIsWrong: The last four chart rows gave Levels 4-5, first item and two items to Darius (and Level 6 to Skill) while whys[3] through whys[6] all argue Jax: the ranked Counter Strike dodge-stun, the Armor/MR wall that keeps him above the execute line, the first-item duel, and 'no juggernaut out-duels you'.
audit.why: The mirror audit already set both layers of the Darius page to Darius / Darius / Darius / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax, and the reasons on this side agree from level 4 onward. Jax at 53.74% survives the early pull lane and owns everything after it.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 3 Darius, Levels 4-5 onward Jax.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late name Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might', and wants.you[2] writes 'Grandmaster's Armor'.
audit.why: The mirror audit identified this as a repo-wide stale name — the pre-rework name for Grandmaster at Arms — and noted the packet's near-miss detector cannot catch it because it flags misspellings, not obsolete-but-correctly-spelled names.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (110s at rank 1). Spikes: Darius owns 1-3 on Apprehend (26s at rank 1) and the bleed; Jax spikes at 3 with a ranked Counter Strike, at 6, and at first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer says 'Counter Strike flips every AA exchange' and reduces the lane to tracking Apprehend, with no mention of the two mechanics that actually decide it.
audit.why: Decimate's outer ring is the full-damage half AND the half that heals him — standing inside the axe turns his Q into chip with no heal. Counter Strike (17s at rank 1) dodges attacks, so it eats his autos but not the Q. And Noxian Guillotine is true damage: Grandmaster at Arms' resists reduce none of it, so the R only helps by keeping your health above the threshold.
audit.corrected: Fight from inside the axe: the outer ring is full damage plus his heal. Bait Apprehend (26s at rank 1), then Leap Strike in. R's resists do not reduce the Guillotine — they keep you above its threshold.
sources: enemyKit Q text/heal, E cd 26, R trueDamage

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Darius must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Your combo is one ability short and he can still E-pull you into five bleed stacks — the level is still his.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A ranked Counter Strike dodges his autos and Q damage, then stuns for an Empowered Leap Strike — make him commit Decimate into it.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Darius's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR lets you tank a Noxian Might Q and stay above the Guillotine execute line while you grind him.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force plus R out-sustains his bleed — all-in while Apprehend (26s) is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Darius carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, no juggernaut out-duels you: your resists and on-hit ramp grind through Hemorrhage and deny the reset.

edits.before: Hold E until Darius commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Hold E for his Decimate wind-up, recast to stun, then Leap Strike in with Empower loaded and out-stat him.

edits.before: Hold E until Darius commits, Counter-Strike the engage, Q onto him with W loaded, and out-stat the rest.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges his autos and the Q's damage — bait Apprehend, then stun and Empower-burst him.

edits.before: That is Darius's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Five stacks means Noxian Might and a lowered Guillotine threshold — refuse it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The outer ring is full damage and heals him — fight from inside it.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in starts on the pull. E the follow-up. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — 26s at rank 1, and his all-in starts on the pull. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Darius carry threat: 9/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Grandmaster at Arms stats win every extended duel from here on — build your teamfight around that. Darius carry threat: 9/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
